pap_intro_one: Wilfrido ta konosí pa su novelanan. Mayoria ta novela romantiko manera e mes a yamanan òf novelita instruktivo, òf novela historiko.
pap_intro_two: Durante e investigashon a deskubrí algun buki di poesia di Wilfrido. Den algun publikashon  e tabata kuminsá ku un kantika. I aki aya por a topa ‘Kos di hari’, un chiste kórtiku komo ñapa.
en_intro_one: Wilfrido is known for his novels. Most are romantic novels, as he called them himself, or instructional novellas or historical novels.
en_intro_two: During the research, several books of poetry by Wilfrido were discovered. Some publications opened with a song. Here and there, readers could also find “Kos di hari,” a short joke added as a little extra.
